profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience in devops, full-stack development, cyber security, algorithms, and data structures. Proficient knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Python, Java, C, C++, HTML, Golang,  Javascript, and the Django Framework.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Agile oriented, full stack position, that included SRE responsibilities.
- Worked with teams managing projects for Platform One (https://repo1.dso.mil)
- Engineered plugins for Mattermost using Golang, React, Typescript, and PostgresSQL.
- Analyzed CVEs within SonarQube scans to filter out false positives.
- Utilized K9s to gather and curate a document of running OPA violations defined by the constraint
templates inside test clusters.
- Wrote unit tests for plugins in order to ensure code coverage.
- Containerized plugins to run within an intricate DevOps pipeline.
- Hardened containers with YAML and validated security with CI/CD pipelines.
- Monitored deployments via AWS, Prometheus, Kibana, ArgoCD, Kubernetes.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Fixed bugs and developed enhancements with Python, HTML and Javascript.
- Debugged and quality tested applications using Linux and Docker.
- Collaborated with other interns, discussed approaches to bugs and enhancements.
- All of my contributions can be viewed here: https://bit.ly/3BQZuuC

positions.title: Code Sprint Participant
positions.description:
- Program where students contribute code to OWASP Projects.
- Worked on DefectDojo, a python based web application used for vulnerability management.
- Fixed bugs and developed enhancements with Python, HTML and JavaScript.
- Details about the program can be found here: https://bit.ly/2XEwRCf

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Assisted with penetration testing efforts via burpsuite and nmap in order to gauge the security of our
various systems.
- Prepared reports of the efforts for leadership.
